name: electronic-sheeps
description: Evidence-driven evolution stress tests for coding agents

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import {readdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'; for (const dir of ['src','bin','scripts']) { let files; try {files=readdirSync(dir)} catch {continue} for (const file of files) if(file.endsWith('.mjs')) execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',dir+'/'+file],{stdio:'inherit'}); }"
